skills.name: Subtract common-denominator fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractions already expressed with a common denominator by subtracting numerators, retaining the denominator, and recognizing zero-numerator results.

skills.name: Use common denominators
skills.definition: Find a common denominator for unlike fractional parts and rewrite the fractions as equivalent fractions before subtraction.

skills.name: Subtract mixed or whole parts without regrouping
skills.definition: Handle mixed-number or whole-number operands when no borrowing is needed by aligning whole and fractional parts, subtracting whole parts, and recombining the result.

skills.name: Borrow in mixed or whole subtraction
skills.definition: Handle mixed-number or whole-number subtraction when the fractional difference is negative by borrowing one or more wholes and adding denominator-equivalent units to the fractional part.

skills.name: Simplify fractional results
skills.definition: Reduce a nonzero fractional part in the final answer to lowest terms.
